listeningQuestions.audio: My first day at senior high was both exciting and a little scary.
opts: 我高中的第一天既兴奋又有点吓人。

listeningQuestions.audio: I joined the badminton club to stay fit and make new friends.
opts: 我加入羽毛球社来健身并结识新朋友。

listeningQuestions.audio: His kind words made me feel a lot more relaxed.
opts: 他的话让大家都生气了。
他温和的话让我放松了许多。

listeningQuestions.audio: Keep calm and be prepared, and you will make a good start.
opts: 保持镇定、做好准备,你就会有个好的开始。

listeningQuestions.audio: Orientation Day is a great chance to get to know the school.
opts: 迎新日是了解学校的好机会。

listeningQuestions.audio: I am really looking forward to the new school year.

quizQuestions.q: On Orientation Day, you get a great ____ to know the school.
New students often feel under ____ during the first week.
In the science club, we ____ questions about nature.
I wanted to make a good first ____ on my new teachers.
The teacher ____ us a useful book about study skills.
Mr Meng's advice made every student more ____.
Before the speech, I felt very ____.
The teacher's question made the noisy room ____.

opts: 我们一个接一个地做自我介绍。
quizQuestions.audio: We introduced ourselves to the class one by one.

opts: 做最重要的任务时,要先列一张清单。
quizQuestions.audio: To do the most important tasks, first make a clear list.

reading.passage: Starting senior high is a brand-new chapter. The first weeks may feel hard, but if you stay calm, join in and help others, every challenge becomes a chance to grow.
reading.passageCn: 升入高中是全新的篇章。最初的几周也许会很艰难,但只要你保持镇定、积极参与、乐于助人,每一个挑战都会变成成长的机会。

questions.q: How may the first weeks of senior high feel?
What does each challenge become, according to the passage?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about your first day at senior high. Say one thing that happened, what you did, and how you felt. Try to use one SVOC sentence (e.g. made me relaxed) and one SVP sentence (e.g. I felt nervous).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写写你高中的第一天:发生了一件什么事、你怎么做的、你的感受。试着用一个'主谓宾补'句(如 made me relaxed)和一个'主系表'句(如 I felt nervous)。

lines.text: How was your first day at senior high?
lines.cn: 你高中第一天过得怎么样?

lines.text: Great, but I felt really nervous when I introduced myself.
lines.cn: 很棒,不过自我介绍时我特别紧张。

lines.text: Me too! Did anything funny happen?
lines.cn: 我也是!发生什么好笑的事了吗?

lines.text: Yes. My name was the same as the teacher's, and everyone laughed. His kind words made me feel relaxed.
lines.cn: 有啊。我和老师同名,大家都笑了。他温和的话让我放松了下来。
